{{Top|leg}}
A '''spice respiratory apparatus''' was a device used by the [[Spice Blades]], the [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] of the [[spice lord]] [[Cassius Nolath Rha]]. The apparatuses pumped humidified [[Carsunum/Legends|black spice]] into their [[Lung/Legends|lungs]] which enhanced their fighting prowess but also weakened their minds, which made them unswervingly loyal to [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Rha.
